paragraphs: Render standard = the OpenUI Lang plan. Runbook: brain projects/calc/files/sprint-render-v2/SPRINT.md (plan: projects/calc/topics/openui-render-arch-plan-2026-10-18.md). No new view/widget format.
A code-gated STEM drill site (CALC1 / PHYS / CSCI26). It's a static page plus a small Python server, serve.py.
features: Problems: one file, problems.json. Every problem, answer, wrong answer and hint. Format: SCHEMA.md (the only schema).
Server: serve.py reads it, sends the browser only the public part of the problem whose code was typed (GET /p/.json) and grades on POST /check. Edit or replace the file: live on the next request.
Upload: the page's upload button (or the picker when the server is down) takes one problems.json and loads every problem in it.
Practice banks: banks/BANKXXX.json (same format). Type BANKXXX in the code box: its questions become the list, and the server keeps each browser's progress and place (design/BANK.md). Ships empty.
Name the file BANK + 3–6 capital letters or digits, e.g. BANKCE3.json. Any other name is skipped (the server prints one line saying so). ce3-traps.json → rename to BANKCE3.json.
